files.description: Harness-targeting via flat, suffixed skill folders — the accepted decision governing skill-registry-harness-targeting. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Hatch CLI runtime: TypeScript on Node.js, npm-distributed — the accepted decision governing cli-runtime. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Registry fetch model: per-subdirectory GitHub tarball fetch, no local clone or cache — the accepted decision governing registry-data. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Version control platform: GitHub for both repos — the accepted decision governing version-control. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Registry authentication: token-as-password, env var over home-directory file — the accepted decision governing auth. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
CLI distribution: public npm registry, npx as primary invocation — the accepted decision governing cli-distribution. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Deployment/CI-CD: GitHub Actions, tag-triggered npm release — the accepted decision governing deployment. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Branching strategy: trunk-based with required-status-check branch protection — the accepted decision governing branching-strategy. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Skill/group versioning: semver per folder, CI-enforced bumps, automatic version tags — the accepted decision governing registry-versioning. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Manifest schema evolution: versioned field + automatic in-code migration on read — the accepted decision governing data-migrations. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Testing: Vitest, unit + mocked-integration, no live end-to-end in CI — the accepted decision governing testing. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Formal checks: Biome + tsc, enforced in CI and locally via pre-commit hook — the accepted decision governing formal-checks. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Skill-content registry: group structure, pointers, and name permanence — the accepted decision governing skill-registry-group-structure. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Registry collision detection: one CLI-owned check, invoked from both repos — the accepted decision governing registry-collision-detection. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Manifest bootstrap: a dedicated `hatch init` command owns initial harness selection — the accepted decision governing manifest-bootstrap. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Manifest schema v2: record group membership per skill, and the group itself, in `hatch.manifest.json` — the accepted decision governing data-migrations. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Local-edit detection for re-import: a stored per-skill `contentHash` in the manifest — the accepted decision governing data-migrations. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Registry "removed" metadata flag: a boolean `removed` field on `skill.json` — the accepted decision governing skill-registry-group-structure. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Standalone version pinning: manifest `pin` field and `<name>@<spec>` argument parsing — the accepted decision governing data-migrations. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.

Block a first-time import of a removed skill/group; keep every other removed-flag encounter warn-only — the accepted decision governing skill-registry-group-structure. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
`hatch remove`'s AF-2/AF-3 gating: `--force-all`/`--force-clean` flags, not an interactive prompt — the accepted decision governing cli-remove-command. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
`hatch remove --harness`'s drop path is unconditional — no drift/local-edit gating — the accepted decision governing cli-remove-command. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Destination-path collision predicate: distinct physical sources, not name shape — the accepted decision governing registry-collision-detection. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Harness-code shadowing risk: accepted, not engineered against — the accepted decision governing registry-collision-detection. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.

Git is an optional dependency: Hatch commits when a repository is there, and works without one — the accepted decision governing version-control-integration. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.

Testing skills: a declared, `_`-prefixed class of registry content that is exempt from name permanence and never importable into an ordinary project — the accepted decision governing skill-registry-group-structure. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.

Registry discovery: a live walk over the contents API, with descriptions read from wherever each kind of content already keeps its prose — the accepted decision governing registry-discovery. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.

Machine-check context `greptile-review`: a record may name its judge, and the runner reports it as delegated — the accepted decision governing decision-record-convention. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.

Continuous code review: Greptile on both repositories, standards in-repo, cross-repository records via a repo cluster — the accepted decision governing continuous-code-review. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
Group pointer version constraints: exact pin or caret, resolved before a no-op — the accepted decision governing skill-registry-group-structure. Enforce what it mandates; do not restate it.
